headword: {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}
gloss: customer service; customer support; dealing with clients

definitions.gloss: customer service; customer support; dealing with clients
definitions.explanation: the process of handling customer inquiries, complaints, and requests

examples.japanese: {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received training in customer service.

examples.japanese: {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧な⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}される→信頼する：22988_shinraisuru⟧。
examples.english: Companies with polite customer service earn trust.

examples.japanese: ⟦クレーム→クレーム：27399_kureemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われて→追う：02016_ou⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: I was busy all day dealing with customer complaints.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧ (customer, client) + ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (handling, dealing with). A standard business term for the function of attending to customers' needs, whether in person, by phone, or online.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧: quality of customer service
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: customer service counter/desk
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧: customer service manual
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to handle customer service
- {顧客対応|こきゃくたいおう}{力|りょく}: customer service ability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{接客|せっきゃく}→接客：12882_sekkyaku⟧: customer service — emphasizes face-to-face interaction with customers
- ⟦カスタマーサポート→カスタマーサポート：26396_kasutamaasapooto⟧: customer support — the loanword equivalent, used mainly in tech/online contexts
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: guest/customer handling — more casual version
- ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: complaint handling — specifically dealing with complaints
